title: Dana Point Sportfishing
specs: Whale watching includes sightings of whales, dolphins, sharks, marlin, seals, sun fish, and other sea life
Boats travel at over 30 knots for quick access to wildlife and fishing spots
Fishing license required for all anglers 16 and older; day fishing permit about $15
Open party fishing trips limited to 3 anglers

blurb: Guests fish for species like Bluefin Tuna, Yellowfin, White Sea Bass, Halibut, and Yellowtail on private or small-group charters. Whale watching trips offer sightings of whales, dolphins, and other marine wildlife aboard private boats. Harbor cruises and sunset cruises are also available.
extraNote: Guests must have a copy of their fishing license on day of departure · Dana Point Harbor
